questions.stem: Which type of bond is formed between hydrogen and chlorine atoms in the HCl molecule?
questions.solution: Hydrogen and chlorine atoms share electrons to form a covalent bond, which is the type of bond that holds them together in HCl. Ionic bonds involve the transfer of electrons, metallic bonds occur between metal atoms, and hydrogen bonds are weak attractions between molecules, not within a molecule.

questions.stem: What is the main reason noble gases do not form chemical bonds?
choices: They have a complete electron octet/duplet
They are gases at room temperature
They have a high atomic mass
questions.solution: The main reason noble gases do not form chemical bonds is that they have a complete electron octet or duplet, which makes them stable and unreactive. The other options are incorrect because being a gas at room temperature, having a high atomic mass, or being non-reactive metals do not explain their lack of bonding ability.

questions.stem: In the formation of sodium chloride, what happens to the sodium atom?
questions.solution: In the formation of sodium chloride, the sodium atom loses an electron, which allows it to achieve a stable electron configuration by forming a Na⁺ ion. Gaining an electron would make it negatively charged, sharing an electron is characteristic of covalent bonding, and becoming a neutral atom would not result in the ionic bond necessary for sodium chloride.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a chemical change?
questions.solution: Rusting of iron is a chemical change because it involves a reaction that forms new substances, such as iron oxide. Melting ice and dissolving sugar are physical changes as they only alter the state or form of the substance without creating new ones. Breaking glass is also a physical change because it does not alter the chemical composition of the material.

hi.solution: लोहे का जंग लगना एक रासायनिक परिवर्तन है क्योंकि इसमें नए पदार्थ, जैसे लौह ऑक्साइड, के बनने में अभिक्रिया होती है। बर्फ का पिघलना और चीनी का पानी में घुलना भौतिक परिवर्तन हैं क्योंकि इनमें केवल पदार्थ के अवस्था या रूप में परिवर्तन होता है बिना नए पदार्थों के बनाए। कांच का टूटना भी एक भौतिक परिवर्तन है क्योंकि इसमें पदार्थ के रासायनिक संघटन में कोई परिवर्तन नहीं होता।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, options, and solution. Technical terms like 'रासायनिक परिवर्तन' (chemical change) and 'भौतिक परिवर्तन' (physical change) are standard in Hindi science textbooks.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of an ionic bond?
questions.solution: Sodium chloride (NaCl) is an example of an ionic bond because it forms when sodium donates an electron to chlorine, creating oppositely charged ions that attract each other. Hydrogen, water, and oxygen molecules involve shared electrons, which is characteristic of covalent bonds, not ionic bonds.

questions.stem: In the reaction of calcium carbonate with hydrochloric acid, which of the following is a product?
questions.solution: Calcium chloride is a product of the reaction between calcium carbonate and hydrochloric acid because the carbonate reacts with the acid to form a salt, carbon dioxide, and water. Calcium oxide, calcium hydroxide, and calcium sulphate are not formed in this reaction as they do not result from the combination of calcium carbonate with hydrochloric acid.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a reversible chemical change?
questions.solution: Dissolving salt in water is a reversible process because the salt can be recovered by evaporating the water, showing no permanent chemical change. Burning paper, cooking an egg, and rusting iron involve chemical reactions that produce new substances and cannot be easily reversed.

questions.stem: Why does sodium form a cation during the formation of sodium chloride?
questions.solution: Sodium loses an electron because it has a single electron in its outermost shell, which it readily donates to achieve a stable electron configuration. This loss results in a positively charged ion, making 'It loses an electron' the correct answer. Gaining an electron would make it negatively charged, sharing an electron is characteristic of covalent bonds, and forming a covalent bond does not result in a cation.

hi.stem: सोडियम क्लोराइड के निर्माण के दौरान सोडियम धनायन बनता क्यों है?
choices: यह एक इलेक्ट्रॉन ग्रहण करता है
यह एक इलेक्ट्रॉन हानि करता है
यह एक इलेक्ट्रॉन साझा करता है
hi.solution: सोडियम एक इलेक्ट्रॉन हानि करता है क्योंकि इसके बाह्यतम कोश में एक इलेक्ट्रॉन होता है, जिसे एक स्थिर इलेक्ट्रॉन व्यवस्था प्राप्त करने के लिए आसानी से दान कर दिया जाता है। इस हानि के कारण धनायन बनता है, इसलिए 'यह एक इलेक्ट्रॉन हानि करता है' सही उत्तर है। इलेक्ट्रॉन ग्रहण करने से यह ऋणायन बन जाएगा, इलेक्ट्रॉन साझा करना सहसंयोजक बंधन की विशेषता है, और सहसंयोजक बंधन बनाने से धनायन नहीं बनता।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi scientific terminology.

mr.stem: सोडियम क्लोराइड तयार करताना सोडियम कॅटायन बनतो का? कारण काय?
mr.solution: सोडियम इलेक्ट्रॉन गमावतो कारण त्याच्या बाह्यतम कक्षेत एक इलेक्ट्रॉन असतो, जो त्याला स्थिर इलेक्ट्रॉन विन्यास प्राप्त करण्यासाठी देतो. या गमावण्यामुळे त्याला धनावेश असलेला आयन मिळतो, ज्यामुळे 'ते इलेक्ट्रॉन गमावते' हे बरोबर उत्तर असते. इलेक्ट्रॉन मिळवणे त्याला ऋणावेश असलेला बनवते, इलेक्ट्रॉन शेअर करणे सहसंयोजक बंधाची वैशिष्ट्ये आहे आणि सहसंयोजक बंध तयार करणे आयॉन तयार करत नाही.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a result of the sharing of electrons between atoms?
questions.solution: A covalent bond forms when atoms share electrons, which directly results from the described process. Ionic bonds involve the transfer of electrons, not sharing. Metallic bonds involve the delocalization of electrons among atoms, not sharing between specific atoms. Hydrogen bonds are weak intermolecular forces, not bonds formed by electron sharing.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा परमाणुओं के बीच इलेक्ट्रॉनों के साझाकरण का परिणाम है?

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते अणूमध्ये इलेक्ट्रॉन शेअर करण्याचे परिणाम आहे?
